summary:
ASTRA – Astronaut Smart Health & Risk Assessment
ASTRA is an intelligent health monitoring platform designed to support astronaut health awareness during space missions. Spaceflight conditions can affect human physiology, making continuous and personalized health monitoring essential.
Unlike traditional monitoring systems that rely on fixed health thresholds, ASTRA focuses on understanding each astronaut's individual health patterns. It establishes a Personal Health Baseline, analyzes incoming health indicators, and detects unusual changes that may require attention.
The platform provides a Mission Health Dashboard to visualize vital indicators and health trends, an Anomaly Detection system to identify abnormal patterns, and Explainable Alerts that highlight what changed and which data supports the alert. ASTRA also aims to support offline-first operation, allowing local health-data analysis when internet connectivity is unavailable.
By combining personalized monitoring, anomaly detection, and explainable insights, ASTRA aims to help astronauts and ground-support teams make more informed decisions and improve health awareness during space missions.
Our Vision: Moving beyond monitoring health numbers toward understanding individual health patterns and identifying unusual changes.
details:
ASTRA – Astronaut Smart Health & Risk Assessment is an intelligent health-monitoring platform designed to support astronaut health awareness during space missions.
Spaceflight conditions can affect the human body in different ways. Traditional monitoring systems often rely on fixed thresholds, but individual astronauts may have different normal health patterns. ASTRA addresses this challenge by focusing on personalized health monitoring.
The platform establishes a Personal Health Baseline for each astronaut and analyzes available health indicators to identify unusual changes or patterns. It presents these insights through a Mission Health Dashboard and provides Explainable Alerts that highlight what changed and which data supports the alert.
ASTRA is designed to support offline-first operation, allowing health data to be analyzed locally when internet connectivity is unavailable.
The project's main benefits include improved health awareness, easier monitoring of individual health trends, and better-informed decisions for astronauts and ground-support teams. Its creative approach is the shift from monitoring isolated health readings to understanding each astronaut's personal health patterns.
The project draws on relevant space-health research and data resources, including NASA's Open Science Data Repository, while distinguishing available research data from demonstration or synthetic data.
Our vision is to make astronaut health monitoring more personalized, understandable, and supportive of safer space missions.
